id: Settle For Less Before You Exit
folderName: Settle For Less Before You Exit
setting: デートをドタキャンされた友人Aに対し、ずっと見守ってきた幼馴染・男友達Bが「彼ではなく僕を選んで」と熱く語りかけるシーン。
lyrics:
Everybody deserves somebody,
But, girl, nobody can love you like I do.

You could be a super model,
President or write a novel.
But he's holding you back
And you're better than that.
He won't even buy you flowers,
Stay up late and talk for hours.
I think I can do that
I can be better than that.
You should know...

Everybody deserves somebody,
But, girl, nobody can love you like I do.
And I'm not perfect but you're so worth it.
I wanna change the world for you,
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best,
So baby don't settle for less.

I've been watching from the sidelines
His mistakes become my guidelines.
'Cause he's holding you back
And you're better than that.
I will love to buy you flowers,
Take the time to talk for hours.
Yeah I can do that.
I can be better than that.
You should know...

Everybody deserves somebody,
But, girl, nobody can love you like I do.
And I'm not perfect but you're so worth it.
I wanna change the world for you,
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best,
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best,
So baby don't settle for less.

He takes you for granted,
Girl, I can't stand it.
Watching you panic over him.
See he's just a nobody
I can be somebody,
Someone to love til' the end.

'Cause everybody deserves somebody,
But, girl, nobody can love you like I do.
And I'm not perfect but you're so worth it.
I wanna change the world for you
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best
So baby don't settle for less.
You deserve the best,
You're better than the rest
And I can be the best
So baby don't settle for less.

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Maybe I'm asking for too much by wanting him to show up.
sentences.displayHtml: Maybe I'm asking for too much by wanting him to show up.

conversation.japanese: またキャンセルされた。ちゃんと来てほしいって、求めすぎなのかな。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: He takes you for granted, and you deserve someone who makes time for you.
sentences.displayHtml: He takes you for granted, and you deserve someone who makes time for you.

conversation.japanese: そんなことないよ。彼は君の好意を当然だと思ってる。時間を作ってくれる人がいいよ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I know, but walking away is hard.
sentences.displayHtml: I know, but walking away is hard.

sentences.text: Why do you care so much?
sentences.displayHtml: Why do you care so much?

conversation.japanese: わかってるけど、別れるのは難しい。どうしてそんなに気にかけてくれるの？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Because I have feelings for you.
sentences.displayHtml: Because I have feelings for you.

sentences.text: But you don't have to decide anything about us now.
sentences.displayHtml: But you don't have to decide anything about us now.

conversation.japanese: 君が好きだから。でも、僕たちのことを今決めなくていい。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I need some time to figure out what I want.
sentences.displayHtml: I need some time to figure out what I want.

conversation.japanese: 気づかなかった。自分がどうしたいか考える時間がほしい。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Whatever you choose, don't settle for less than being treated well.
sentences.displayHtml: Whatever you choose, don't settle for less than being treated well.

conversation.japanese: ゆっくり考えて。どんな選択でも、大切にされることは妥協しないで。

lyricConnections.explanationJa: take someone for granted は、その人の好意や存在を当然のものとして扱うこと。
settle for less は、本来望むものより低い条件で妥協すること。
